collective-navy.$description: Collective Navy — Primary headings, primary CTA button fill, brand mark, active navigation — the only saturated color on the page, used to anchor identity and signal action

inkwell.$description: Inkwell — Primary body text, high-emphasis copy, button text on light backgrounds, icon strokes — the default text color across nearly all contexts

slate-ink.$description: Slate Ink — Secondary headings, icon strokes, body text where slightly lighter weight is needed

pencil-graphite.$description: Pencil Graphite — Tertiary headings and supporting labels, slightly softer than Inkwell for hierarchy breaks

muted-slate.$description: Muted Slate — Secondary body text, list items, captions that need to remain readable but recede

distant-mist.$description: Distant Mist — Muted helper text, secondary icons, tertiary link color — supporting information that should not compete with primary content

frost-border.$description: Frost Border — Hairline borders, card outlines, input borders, dividers, table separators — the structural neutral, used at extremely high frequency

silver-whisper.$description: Silver Whisper — Subtle placeholder text, disabled chrome, decorative dividers

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button fills, input fields — the dominant surface color

inter.$description: Single-family system: weight 800 at 60–72px for hero/display headlines (signature — no separate display face), weight 700 for H1–H2, weight 600 for subheadings and button labels, weight 500 for nav and labels, weight 400 for body. The use of a single neo-grotesque across all roles, leaning on extreme weight contrast (400 vs 800) rather than a second typeface, gives the system a calm, documentary feel.
